honesty.confidenceRules: Observed is reserved for established structural facts. Predicted or dependency hops must never use Observed. Missing or invalid confidence defaults to Unknown.
honesty.evidenceRules: Demo evidence uses example.invalid citations and curated-baseline notes. Never treat these as live news.
honesty.layout: Radial-from-focus with progressive expand-on-click. Mobile uses stacked expand panels. No force-directed layout.

edges.why: Perishable foods and cold-chain windows are sensitive to terminal slowdowns. Households may notice thinner selection or higher prices if stoppages last — that pass-through is analysis, not an established fact.

Even when malware hits IT systems, operators may pause physical product movement as a precaution. Local station shortages can appear within days if terminals starve — price paths remain uncertain and must not be labeled Observed.

Hospitals and clinics often hold buffers, but prolonged terminal delays can tighten restock windows for non-urgent supplies. Any household access effect is conditional and must stay Low/Medium — never Observed as a prediction.

Steel is a common construction input. Higher landed costs can pressure project budgets over months. Pass-through to household housing costs is plausible but not automatic — contracts and inventories matter.

After visible cyber incidents, insurers may reprice cyber coverage for related sectors over months. Households usually feel this indirectly through business costs or specialized policies — treat as Low-confidence literacy, not a rate quote.

When advanced chips are scarce or delayed, electronics and device makers may stretch lead times. Households might notice longer waits or higher prices for some devices over months — concentration literacy, not a geopolitical verdict.

Longer voyages raise bunker fuel use and schedule uncertainty. Passenger and freight travel costs can become more sensitive over days to weeks — duration depends on security conditions that are not knowable from the advisory alone.

Lower reservoir or corridor water can constrain hydropower output and raise reliance on other generation. Household utility bills may shift over weeks to months depending on regional mix — that path is labeled analysis, not fact.
